_note: Register: standard Malay for software, polite but not officialese; anda in prose (lowercase mid-sentence -- Malay orthography has no rule capitalising it the way Indonesian's EYD does), bare verb stems on buttons (Eksport, Simpan, Batal, Tutup). Terms of art: a printed face is sisi and a sheet is helai (Kamus Dewan has lembar as a classifier too, glossed helai, but its noun lembar is a thread or a string, where helai is also the thin, wide sheet itself, which the file names as well as counts), so "4 faces / 2 sheets" is "4 sisi / 2 helai"; duplex is bolak-balik; typeface is jenis huruf; romanisation is romanisasi; the respelling field is Cara sebut and the literal gloss Erti harfiah (erti, not Indonesian's arti); "glossed into" is Erti dalam. Interpolation follows the same rule id's own note records: Intl.DisplayNames hands Malay the bare ethnonym, so every {language} template carries the head noun bahasa in front of it. Malaysia's own vocabulary choices (awak not kamu, mahu not mau, bahagian not bagian, peguam not pengacara, etc.) are applied throughout via the same substitution table tmp/scripts/ms_build.py uses for the corpus; see tmp/notes/malay.md. preview.lockDate and preview.lockTime are left out for the same reason lo/ml/mr/ne/or/pa/pl/ro/ru already record: the lock-screen mock now takes its sample date and time from CLDR, and en.json's text is only the floor for locales Intl has never heard of. Most used and speak-on-tap keys (26): board.tapSpeaks is Sebut apabila diketik, board.speak's Sebut with the file's ketik (about.unset, beacon.dismiss, and "press" in board.arrangeHint) and resume.heading's apabila; display.tapSpeaks opens with the same words and display.tapNoVoice quotes it as its subject, as display.siren quotes “Tarik perhatian”. "The grid stays" is skrin tidak berubah, which says what the reader sees: no message opens over the buttons. Where the file does name a grid it says grid (Kamus Dewan, Komp), in format.arrangementTitle.mixed. The counts are kiraan (ketikan), and reset is Set semula, the form Malay Wikipedia gives a reset button or pin; neither touches the corpus's bil. The windows are 7 hari terakhir / 30 hari terakhir / 12 bulan terakhir, the spans the code counts: N hari lepas and N hari yang lalu both mean "N days ago", and minggu lepas is the calendar week. usage.scopeOne keeps the head noun (Bahasa {language} sahaja), not addTerm.inLanguage's Dalam bahasa, which beside a count reads as counting in that language; usage.scopeAll is board.toGallery's Semua bahasa, usage.resetNo arrange.removeNo's Biarkan, and a question is pertanyaan as in drill.*. Words checked against Kamus Dewan on PRPM, with MABBIM's Malaysian column where the dictionary lists both (tmp/notes/agents/strings-ms-audit.md): a column is lajur (Kamus Dewan has no kolom), a printer pencetak, ink dakwat and a mode mod (MABBIM, against Indonesian tinta and mode), preview pratonton, default lalai, layout susun atur, shown dipaparkan (paparan, not tampilan), emergency kecemasan, skip langkau, list senarai, loading memuatkan (memuat is to hold), tick tandakan, switch on hidupkan, both kedua-dua (kedua alone is second), sahaja not saja, and ialah before a noun phrase (Tatabahasa Dewan); the sheet itself is helai too, not only its count. pakai, meski, setidaknya, hemat and harus are Kamus Dewan Malay and stay.

check.intro: Semua yang diperlukan oleh kedua-dua bahasa ini, dimuatkan daripada peranti ini dan diuji mengikut cara papan menggunakannya. Jalankan ini di rumah, sebelum perjalanan.

offline.tip: Aplikasi ini berfungsi tanpa sambungan sebaik sahaja sesuatu bahasa disimpan pada peranti ini. Simpan bahasa yang anda perlukan sebelum berangkat, dan padamkannya selepas itu untuk mengosongkan semula ruang.
offline.used: Aplikasi ini menggunakan {size} pada peranti ini.
offline.partly: Disimpan sebahagian: {count} fail tidak sampai. Cuba lagi dengan sambungan yang lebih baik.
offline.clearAsk: Padam setiap bahasa yang disimpan pada peranti ini? Aplikasi tetap berfungsi dengan sambungan, dan apa-apa sahaja boleh disimpan semula.
offline.cleared: Sudah dipadam. Semuanya boleh disimpan semula dengan sambungan.

display.tapSpeaks: Sebut apabila diketik: butang terus menyebut ayatnya dan skrin tidak berubah

boards.mostUsed.title: Paling kerap digunakan
mostUsed.empty: Butang yang paling kerap anda ketik, daripada semua konteks, berkumpul di sini.
usage.lede: Skrin “Paling kerap digunakan” menunjukkan dahulu butang yang paling kerap anda ketik. Kiraannya dibuat pada peranti ini sahaja.
usage.resetBody: Setiap kiraan tentang kekerapan anda mengetik butang dipadam daripada peranti ini, dan “Paling kerap digunakan” kembali kosong. Butang dan tetapan anda kekal.
